rules.quote: The Realtime API Beta was deprecated and removed from the API on May 12, 2026.
rules.summary: Sends `OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1` or uses the beta Realtime client. The beta was removed on 2026-05-12 and the GA interface differs (session shape and event names); OpenAI's migration guide describes the differences but no one-to-one mapping, so Refit lists it for review.

rules.quote: Access to the v1 beta will be discontinued on December 18, 2024.
rules.summary: Sends `OpenAI-Beta: assistants=v1`, shut off on 2024-12-18; the whole Assistants API has since shut down too (see the API surface rule).
